title: Great Zimbabwe community
summary: Shona-associated communities built stone enclosures and settlements at Great Zimbabwe. Archaeological finds, including imported beads and ceramics, connect the site to wider networks of exchange beyond southern Africa.

claims.text: Shona-associated communities built stone enclosures and settlements at Great Zimbabwe. Archaeological finds, including imported beads and ceramics, connect the site to wider networks of exchange beyond southern Africa.
Approximate building range; the site includes earlier occupation and later activity.

The surviving masonry and artifacts establish African authorship and extensive regional connections. The site’s construction history should be distinguished from later legends about its origin and from the continuing histories of local communities.
